backup.production_rule: Monthly bill reminders and bill payment in the Staff app (Lloyd 2026-11-20; contract docs/s127/CONTRACT-B-APP.md over CONTRACT-B.md Addenda 1 and 3; the actor is the signed-in staff user, no Telegram). Adds the app_settings row bill_schedule (only if absent; account numbers, payee name, number and note are empty strings) with two restrictive policies hiding that key from anon and every account but manage_staff; table utility_bills (RLS on, service_role only; paying_by and paid_by are auth user ids); 14 internal functions with no grants (bill_step_v1 core, bill_due_open_v1 opener, bill_daily_v1 daily job, bill_push_v1 and the config and entry helpers); eight functions granted to authenticated only, each gating on auth.uid() and the role inside the body: bill_pay_open_v1, bill_pay_settle_v1, bill_pay_cancel_v1, bill_pay_skip_v1, bill_proof_v1 (approve_payment), bill_schedule_get_v1, bill_schedule_set_v1 (manage_staff), and today_bills_v1 (read_operations); a pg_cron job bill-daily-0800-manila (00:00 UTC) calling bill_daily_v1(), which opens bills from the floor month 2026-11 (October 2026 stays closed) and writes one ops_notices reminder per bill, re-dated daily until paid or skipped; extends transactions_source_check with 'bill' behind a guard (55000 on an unknown literal; NOT VALID, then validated); and replaces today_bills_v1 in place behind an md5 guard (lane A body f7cfd2f8ddd001229df63601b636c5b7, this release 70302291441c8493c622ae66befe6b79; 55000 when the live body is neither) adding the key 'due' with can_pay. Every existing key, grant and search_path of today_bills_v1 is unchanged. Push: bill_push_v1 calls notify-staff-inbox when it is deployed; no edge function is built here.

forward_verification.name: today_bills_v1_is_this_release
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '70302291441c8493c622ae66befe6b79' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.today_bills_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: today_bills_v1_grants_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.today_bills_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.today_bills_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.today_bills_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and (select prosecdef and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.today_bills_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: bill_app_functions_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(has_function_privilege('authenticated', f, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', f, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', f, 'execute')) from unnest(array['public.bill_pay_open_v1(uuid)', 'public.bill_pay_settle_v1(uuid,jsonb)', 'public.bill_pay_cancel_v1(uuid)', 'public.bill_pay_skip_v1(uuid)', 'public.bill_proof_v1(uuid)', 'public.bill_schedule_get_v1(uuid,text)', 'public.bill_schedule_set_v1(uuid,text,jsonb)']) f

forward_verification.name: internal_functions_closed
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(not has_function_privilege('anon', f, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', f, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', f, 'execute')) from unnest(array['public.bill_step_v1(uuid,text,uuid,text,jsonb)', 'public.bill_due_open_v1(uuid,date,text)', 'public.bill_daily_v1(date,uuid)', 'public.bill_push_v1(uuid,uuid)', 'public.bill_reply_v1(jsonb,uuid)', 'public.bill_entry_v1(public.utility_bills,jsonb,boolean,uuid)', 'public.bill_pay_info_v1(jsonb,text,text)', 'public.bill_can_v1(uuid)', 'public.bill_actor_name_v1(uuid)', 'public.bill_json_v1(public.utility_bills)', 'public.bill_schedule_cfg_v1()', 'public.bill_cfg_one_v1(jsonb,text,jsonb,integer)', 'public.bill_cfg_day_v1(jsonb,integer)', 'public.bill_cfg_text_v1(jsonb,text)']) f

forward_verification.name: utility_bills_closed_to_api_roles
forward_verification.query: select (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.utility_bills'::regclass) and not has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.utility_bills', 'select,insert,update,delete') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.utility_bills', 'select,insert,update,delete')

forward_verification.name: settings_row_present_and_hidden
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from public.app_settings where key = 'bill_schedule') = 1 and (select count(*) from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'app_settings' and policyname in ('app_settings_bill_schedule_closed_anon', 'app_settings_bill_schedule_closed_staff')) = 2

forward_verification.name: source_check_has_bill
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%''bill''%' from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.transactions'::regclass and conname = 'transactions_source_check'

forward_verification.name: daily_job_scheduled
forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('cron.job') is null or exists (select 1 from cron.job where jobname = 'bill-daily-0800-manila' and schedule = '0 0 * * *' and command = 'select public.bill_daily_v1()')

forward_verification.name: no_bill_rows_yet
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from public.utility_bills) = 0 and (select count(*) from public.transactions where source = 'bill') = 0

rollback.safe_until: Until a bill is marked paid or a transaction with source 'bill' exists: the rollback script refuses after that, because it would drop ledger evidence. Before then: today_bills_v1 goes back to the lane A body, the new functions, table, policies and setting are removed, and transactions_source_check loses 'bill'.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261128_s127_bill_reminders.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; today_bills_v1 must be back to md5 f7cfd2f8ddd001229df63601b636c5b7 and the cron job bill-daily-0800-manila gone. Roll the Staff app back first (it calls the bill_pay_*, bill_proof_v1, bill_schedule_* functions and the due key).

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_follows_the_sql
feature_flags.required_state: None. Old staff builds keep working: today_bills_v1 only gains the key due, which an old build ignores; the new functions are called only by the new Staff app build.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
the live md5 of today_bills_v1 is neither the lane A body nor this release (the migration stops with 55000)
the live transactions_source_check holds a literal the migration does not know (the migration stops with 55000)
the rehearsal has not run the migration and s127_bill_reminders.sql green on this commit, compatibility.verified is still false
